shared_reporting_inbox.rule: Auto-forwards every inbound email to adam@northgate.f2.ai

units: USD millions unless noted. Ratios in x. Headroom in %.

credit_policy.rule: A borrower's status is the worst status across all inputs below.

inputs.input: LTM Adjusted EBITDA as % of underwriting case
Reporting delinquency (days past the credit agreement due date)

credit_policy.status_changes: A status change must be confirmed by the monitoring analyst with a written reason. The analyst may override the computed status with a written reason.
credit_policy.watchlist: Any Amber or Red borrower is reviewed for watchlist. Watchlist borrowers are reviewed monthly by the portfolio manager.
credit_policy.ic_escalation: Red borrowers, and any borrower moving two statuses in one quarter, are presented at the next monthly IC.
credit_policy.borrower_review: The analyst finalizes a borrower review for every borrower each quarter, within 10 business days of receiving a complete package.
credit_policy.note: The policy does not say which figure governs when F2's calculation and the borrower's compliance certificate disagree.

headroom_definition.tightest: The covenant with the lowest headroom for the period.
